title: Concept: Any installed package may run a Composer plugin
description: composer.json declares a `config.allow-plugins` switch that allows every plugin, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A script that runs during install or build executes with the developer or CI identity, before any test or review has looked at the code. This rule reads a `config.allow-plugins` switch that allows every plugin.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through composer.json (composer).
risk: A script that runs during install or build executes with the developer or CI identity, before any test or review has looked at the code. This rule reads a `config.allow-plugins` switch that allows every plugin.
